purpose: Evaluate autonomous use of the EPD Knowledge using a locally served model. Scope is agent answer quality under this protocol.

scenario.agent_backend: vLLM 0.33.0, one H800, Qwen3.8-27B BF16, thinking disabled
scenario.scope: Collect model-selected tool calls for one fixed historical deployment. No final answer or new service measurements scored.
scenario.budget: one allocation, up to 12 minutes, 7 decisions per trial, one retry on structured-response errors

arms.absent: EPD removed from search and unavailable to read

gates.required_for_claim: Only the two prespecified tool behavior rates. Inspect chronology.
gates.knowledge_calculation_attempt: a model-authored calculate request after it opened the EPD case
gates.strong_evidence: calculator expression exposes the minimum of E and PD pool capacities at the supplied rates for all three allocations
gates.baseline: Measure valid rule attempts without case independently; it cannot demonstrate reading a missing case.

fixed_inputs.accelerator: NVIDIA H800, one GPU per effective worker
fixed_inputs.workload: Cold MMMU, 720 single-image validation requests, fixed 64 generation tokens
fixed_inputs.cache_policy: Fresh encoder work without embedding reuse
fixed_inputs.input_scope: Previously recorded rates for this deployment. Use as frozen inputs. No new calibration or load run.
